summary: Implementing a custom (non-Internet Identity) signup flow that routes users to a Jobseeker Profile Setup page after signup, including dynamic experience entries.
architectural_notes: Authentication should be custom (do not use Internet Identity).
Post-signup navigation must route users to the Profile Setup page.
known_issues: After signup, user does not reach the next page (Profile Setup) and the app keeps buffering.

existing_features.title: Fix the infinite loading/buffering after manual signup so that users reliably navigate to the Profile Setup page and can interact with the form immediately (no spinner loop).

Implement the Jobseeker Profile Setup form fields and behavior as specified: collect Name, Mobile Number, Email ID, Current Location, and an Experience status dropdown (Fresher or Experienced). If Experienced is selected, allow the user to add/edit/remove up to 5 experience entries, each with Company Name, Designation, Process, Last Salary, and total duration (months or years).

Persist manual-auth profile completion state so that after completing Profile Setup the user is routed to the correct next page and will not be repeatedly forced back into /profile-setup on subsequent visits.

new_feature_requests.summary: Create custom signup/login flow (not Internet Identity) and redirect to Profile Setup after signup
Build Jobseeker Profile Setup form: name, mobile, email, location, fresher/experienced dropdown; if experienced allow up to 5 experience entries (company, designation, process, last salary, duration)

projectName: Fix post-signup buffering and implement Jobseeker Profile Setup (Fresher/Experienced with up to 5 experiences) using manual auth
